verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh has built-in AI agents for customer screening, ongoing monitoring and transaction monitoring. Teams can assign cases to an agent, which auto-remediates level 1 alerts, escalates high-risk cases to humans, and can be reviewed or overridden. That is real in-product delegation, but it is limited to narrow, domain-specific alert triage and is evidenced only by short marketing-page snippets. Missing for 10: a general-purpose assistant that accepts arbitrary tasks or natural-language requests, in-depth first-party docs on how delegation works, configuration options (the Starter plan says agents cannot be customized), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
